decisions.decision: Task evidence is private/internal by default.
decisions.rationale: Evidence can contain logs, commands, file paths, branch names, and quality-gate output. Public DTOs must be designed separately and must not leak raw labels, metadata, credentials, or unsanitized logs.

decisions.decision: Slice 10-01 stops at persistence primitives only.
decisions.rationale: API routes and dashboard timeline UI belong to later slices so storage, auth, DTO safety, and UI behavior remain testable in small increments.

Do not modify Plankton or OpenHub .claude/settings.json in this phase.
Run GSD health/consistency, dependency drift, diff check, secret scan, focused tests, full backend tests, push, CI, and live health verification before final done report.
